description: This is a Java test class for the EnforcedThingFlattener component, containing unit tests that verify its behavior with various enforcers, input JSON structures, and configurations. It tests the flattening of JSON objects with security/enforcement annotations, handling of features, definitions, null or empty attributes, and array size trimming.

classes.name: EnforcedThingFlattenerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for EnforcedThingFlattener, testing its JSON flattening logic with various enforcers and input structures.

methods.name: testWithAclEnforcer
methods.description: Tests JSON flattening with an ACL enforcer applied to a sample JSON input, ensuring the correct transformation of permissions into flattened entries.

methods.name: testWithPolicyEnforcer
methods.description: Tests JSON flattening with a policy enforcer, verifying correct handling of policy-based permissions and subject labels.

methods.name: testFeatures
methods.description: Verifies flattening of features section in JSON, including handling of feature definitions and properties.

methods.name: testDefinition
methods.description: Checks flattening of a simple definition field within JSON input.

methods.name: testNullOrEmptyAttributes
methods.description: Ensures that null, empty, and non-existent attributes are handled correctly during flattening, with appropriate defaults.

methods.name: testZeroMaxArraySize
methods.description: Tests behavior when the maximum array size parameter is set to zero, verifying that arrays are appropriately truncated or omitted.

methods.name: flattened
methods.description: Helper method to create a flattened JSON value with specific path and value, used in assertions.
